_about: Filters and preferences for rank_prs.py. Edit and re-run the ranker; no re-fetch needed. See 02-choose-pr/references/pr-selection.md.
_filters: minServiceShare: share of the PR's source files Hud sees in the running service. minServiceFiles: at least this many of them. minLines/maxLines: additions + deletions in those service files only, so lockfiles, tests and other services don't count. maxRenameShare: above this share of renamed files, the PR is a move, not a behaviour change.
_preferences: Points per signal that matches. PRs the user wrote or reviewed always sort first; within each group, more points sort first, then the most recent. routes: a changed service file registers HTTP routes. dataAccess: the changed lines build queries or call a database or HTTP client. tests: the PR changes tests (the best source of valid request bodies). type: feat/fix/perf by label or title. focused: its service files sit in at most focusedMaxDirs directories. followUpFix: a later PR fixes this one. described: the description has at least describedMinChars characters or links an issue.
_patterns: routePattern runs over each changed service file's content at the merge commit; dataAccessPattern over the changed lines only.
